contracts.Timer.State: Actual value EXPIRED=3; RUNNING=1, PAUSED=2, RESET=4, MISSED=5.
contracts.Timer.expire: Same ID and length; totalLength=0, remaining=min(0,previous), fresh monotonic/wall start clocks.
contracts.Timer.reset: Same ID, totalLength and remaining restore original length; clocks become Long.MIN_VALUE.
contracts.ExpiredTimersActivity: SingleInstance/empty affinity/non-resizable; actual global expired list, no per-ID Intent URI.
contracts.ExpiredTimersActivity.FabClickListener: Actual onClick calls resetOrDeleteExpiredTimers and then finish(); self-finish is distinct from normal task remove.
contracts.TimerNotificationBuilder.buildHeadsUp: TimerModelNotification channel, explicit ExpiredTimersActivity content and fullScreen PendingIntents; flags NEW_TASK|NO_USER_ACTION; no per-timer extra.
contracts.TimerNotificationBuilder.buildChannel: Initial importance=3; no channel/volume/ringtone mutation in proposed trial.
contracts.TimerService: RESET_EXPIRED_TIMERS resets or deletes global expired list, reinforcing sole-ID requirement; trial never sends this internal Intent.

qualification_limits: Real timer elapsed state and notification/alert delivery are separate readbacks.
Native Stop ACK alone is not business success; same-ID reset and alert self-finish, if applicable, are required.
All original alarm templates remain unchanged.
No artificial invocation of non-exported alert Activity or TimerService.
